text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock D at large gains felt satisfying, but a profitable sale does not show that I can predict prices; I should base future trades on a plan, not the thrill of locking in gains.","I should avoid letting loss aversion or reluctance to admit a mistake make me hold a stock without a sound reason, and avoid selling winners merely to secure gains.","Prices move randomly, so neither recent performance nor my trades so far reliably forecasts what comes next; I should review my portfolio deliberately and trade only when my plan calls for it."]}
